payload.artist_html: G. F. Funston, T. W. Dudgeon, D. J. Simon, D. M. Dufault, C. Boyd, D. Fowler, P. J. Currie & D. C. Evans
payload.credit_html: Supplementary Materials for: "Fruit-eating adaptations in a Late Cretaceous oviraptorosaur (Theropoda)"
payload.description_html: Hand and foot of the holotype of Infernogallus jamesi. Photograph (a), line drawing (b), and reconstruction (c) of the right manus of ROM VP 65050 in lateral view (a, b) and in extensor view (c). Photograph (d) of the surface-collected pedal elements of ROM VP 65050 in extensor view. Abbreviations: I-1, phalanx I-1; II-2, phalanx II-2; III-2, phalanx III-2; III-4, phalanx III-4; IV-2, phalanx IV-2; mt I, metatarsal I; mt II, metatarsal II.
